title: Catapult Construction
start: Talk to the Tyras guard next to the catapult in the Isafdar Forest.

ironman.t: Alternatively, QuestIcon | Carnillean Rising rewards 10 mahogany planks.

items.t: 10 mahogany planks (protean planks will not work)

recommended.t: 56 Agility if entering forest from Port Tyras
A charged amulet of glory or combat bracelet
An arc journal for teleport outside the pub in Port Sarim and Thaki the delivery dwarf

rewards.t: 30 Teak planks (worth NoCoins | GE price | c )
An adamant halberd (worth NoCoins | GE price | c )
Increased damage when using the Castle Wars catapults

steps.t: North of the Tyras camp, talk to the guard next to the catapult. [Chat: Accept › 1 I guess you're going to get fired, then. › 1 What do you suggest? › 1 Alright, I'll go and speak to General Hining.]
Talk to General Hining in Tyras Camp. [Chat: 1 So, the Tyras Camp catapult is broken? › 1 Perhaps I can help to repair it? › 2 General, I believe I can be of service to you.]
p: The Tyras guard wanders near the catapult.

steps.t: Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone, then take the north-western path, cross the leaves trap, and then the sticks trap (south west of the log crossing shortcut) to find the Catapult engineer.
Talk to the Catapult engineer for schematics. [Chat: 3 General Hining asked me to find you. › 2 I'm quite an experienced carpenter.]
Read the schematics. [Chat: 3 Make the repair parts.]
Talk to the engineer again. [Chat: 1 Can I read the letter?]
Talk to Rolad at the Dwarven Mine camp, south of Ice Mountain. (North-east of Falador lodestone) [Chat: 2 Can I have the metal parts for the Tyras Camp catapult please?]
p: A player constructing the mahogany catapult parts.

steps.t: Talk to Thaki inside Port Sarim's pub. [Chat: 2 You're right, I'm not a sailor.]
Wear the sailor's hat and talk to Thaki again.
Return to the catapult north of the Tyras Camp and talk to the guard.
Copy the solution below. Use the big buttons to swap sides.
Talk to the guard. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll have a go.]
Move the catapult left or right so the arrow at the bottom middle aligns with the target rock.

sub.t: Shoot the middle rock - 0/6 green bars on Counterweight.
Left rock (four points left of middle rock) - 5/6 green bars on Counterweight.
Right rock (two points right of middle rock, one turn left from far right) - 6/6 green bars on Counterweight.
